description_en: Deletes an asynchronous document format conversion task by calling the DeleteOfficeConversionTask operation
description_zh: 调用DeleteOfficeConversionTask接口删除异步文档格式转换任务
name: DeleteOfficeConversionTask

parameters.help_en:
The task ID. The TaskId returned after an asynchronous document format conversion (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72044.html) task is executed.

You can obtain the TaskId of an asynchronous document format conversion task from the Task Query tab of the corresponding project in the Intelligent Media Management console.

This operation succeeds even if the TaskId is invalid or does not exist. Make sure that you specify the correct TaskId
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。异步文档格式转换 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72044.html)任务执行后返回的TaskId。

异步文档格式转换任务的TaskId可以通过智能媒体管理控制台对应项目的任务查询页签获取。

当TaskId不合法或者不存在时，此操作仍会执行成功，请确保已设置正确的TaskId
parameters.name: task_id
